issues.title: [Epic · Week 5] Prototype quality, security, and controlled-preview readiness
issues.outcome: Harden the complete synthetic prototype and prepare a controlled, non-indexed deployment suitable for review and a lowiro permission request.
scope: Accessibility, performance, security, privacy, offline, metadata, diagnostics, and preview controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Synthetic-only and no-public-release constraints are enforced.
Permission-request evidence can reference stable prototype artifacts.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 5 · Quality] Accessibility, responsive, image, and Core Web Vitals pass
issues.outcome: Make the synthetic prototype comfortable across keyboard, assistive technology, desktop, and narrow viewports while meeting measured performance budgets.
scope: Core-route audit, zoom/responsive behavior, image/layout stability, bundle/Core Web Vitals budgets, and reduced motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Automated checks have no critical violations.
Media and placeholders have correct dimensions/alt decisions.
Target and observed performance are recorded.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 5 · Quality] Static catalog PWA and offline update strategy
issues.outcome: Evaluate and, only if reliable, provide offline access to the shell and last valid synthetic/approved catalog snapshot.
scope: Cache/version policy, update notice, stale state, storage errors, removal invalidation, and uninstall/rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: Removed content is not retained indefinitely.
PWA remains a scope cut if lifecycle reliability is insufficient.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 5 · Security] Browser, content, dependency, and supply-chain hardening
issues.outcome: Harden the static product, synthetic catalog, and deployment pipeline without enterprise-scale infrastructure.
scope: Threat model content/URLs/images/service worker/actions, pin dependencies/actions, secret/content checks, and hosting limitations.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 5 · Operations] Privacy-respecting errors, feedback, and support diagnostics
issues.outcome: Define diagnostics and feedback for the static preview without invasive tracking.
scope: Error boundary, support bundle, telemetry decision, issue-report redaction, freshness/link checks.
acceptanceCriteria: No personal data is collected by default.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 5 · Quality] Preview metadata, noindex policy, and future public discovery
issues.outcome: Generate deterministic route metadata while keeping the pre-authorization synthetic preview non-indexed and non-promotional.
scope: Titles/descriptions/canonicals for synthetic routes, robots/noindex preview policy, social-preview exclusions, sitemap strategy for later activation, and base-path/404 behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Synthetic preview cannot be indexed as an Arcaea information source.
No unapproved image or real-game claim enters metadata.
Public sitemap/indexing activation is deferred to `public-release-activation`.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.
